claims.predicate: remains the reactor coolant pump (RCP) supplier for
claims.object_value: Westinghouse AP1000 commercial nuclear plants (US + China)
claims.claim_text: Within the Corporation's Naval & Power segment, Electro-Mechanical Division (EMD) is the reactor coolant pump (RCP) supplier for the Westinghouse Electric Company (WEC) AP1000 nuclear power plants in China and the United States... In February 2022, the Corporation and WEC reached an agreement to settle all open claims and counterclaims under the AP1000 U.S. and China contracts. The settlement agreement requires the Corporation to pay WEC $15 million during the first quarter of 2022 and $10 million during the first quarter of 2023.

claims.predicate: agreed to acquire aircraft emergency arresting systems business from
claims.object_value: Safran Aerosystems Arresting Company for $240M, ~$70M FY21 sales
claims.claim_text: On January 21, 2022, the Corporation announced that it has entered into an agreement to acquire the assets that comprise the Safran Aerosystems Arresting Company ('SAA') for $240 million in cash. SAA is a designer and manufacturer of aircraft emergency arresting systems with more than 5,000 systems worldwide. For the year ended December 31, 2021, SAA generated sales of approximately $70 million.
